title: 'one of the most inspiring books I've read in 2026'
summary: Scheipers teaches the Strategy Management module on the Director Effectiveness Programme at GUBERNA, the Belgian institute for board directors, and published an eleven-book reading list for his participants, photographed as a stack. Incorruptible is the only 2026 title among established strategy texts — Christensen, Rumelt, Lafley and Martin, Grant, Simons.
blockquote: thanks for one of the most inspiring books I've read in 2026
attribution_title: Professor of Strategy Management & Academic Director, Antwerp Management School
